axioms.name: Experimental.P06_11.upstream_euler_shift
axioms.meaning: Euler polynomial shift identity E_n(x+1)+E_n(x)=2x^n on the explicit finite Bernoulli definition; an independent prerequisite for the distribution calculation.

typed_coverage: Actual finite odd harmonic sums, odd-square denominator, Euclidean polynomial quotient and a concrete Euler-polynomial definition. Only the independent Euler shift identity is assumed.
missing_domain_interfaces: No local p-adic functional, Euler-number secant normalization, half-weight sum, limiting prime-sum rate or valuation proof has been encoded.
repair_gates: Prove the p-distribution formula from the finite Euler definition before using the exponent shift.
Reconcile Euler polynomial coefficients with the manuscript secant Euler-number convention.
Discharge all quotient and residue valuations on these actual polynomials; do not infer them from scaling alone.
Check the strict linear-growth formulation at k=1 and all error-term quantifiers before adopting a repaired target.
validation: Static source review only; no Lean process, build or axiom audit run.
